exit: 0
--- stdout
Compare two sequences, or two CXF documents, and print the structural diff.

Stdout is the JSON report with the diff (the diff as a Markdown table with --format markdown): exit 0 when nothing differs, 1 for any difference, a reordering or a comment included (summary.graph_equal answers "same structure"). Both sides are one form and are never validated. A side that cannot be read, parsed or loaded is exit 2 with the report.

Usage: oce diff [OPTIONS] <BASE> <HEAD>

Arguments:
  <BASE>
          The base (earlier) side: text (`.oce`), wire (`.json`) or CXF (`.jsonld`, `.cxf.json`), or `-` for stdin

  <HEAD>
          The head (later) side, in the base's form, or `-` for stdin (on one side only)

Options:
      --from <FROM>
          The form of both sides; overrides the names, and is required for stdin
          
          [possible values: cxf, text, wire]

      --render <RENDER>
          When to write a human-readable rendering of the report to stderr
          
          [default: auto]
          [possible values: auto, always, never]

      --no-renames
          Turn the rename pass off: every unmatched block is removed or added, and the diff carries the note rename-pass-off. graph_equal does not change

      --format <FORMAT>
          The document on stdout: the JSON report with the diff, or the diff as a Markdown table. The text rendering goes to stderr under --render
          
          [default: json]
          [possible values: json, markdown]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
--- stderr
